scope: F17 F19 F09 only; F25 watch and explicit-refresh integration coordinated with preview agent

baseline.notes: Production SubmitAddressSearch for content/name and Enter/live did not return to origin or clear history deadline. Real directory worker/navigation returned from scroll 1800/x17 to scroll 2128/x0 while preserving selected child75. Initial folder-load preferences selected Details; final regression explicitly covers Details and LargeIcons.

changes.behavior: Whitespace or empty address search exits through existing cancellation and origin restoration path, cancels delayed history writes, honors composition guard.

Each back/forward entry retains both viewport axes. Loading consumes pending history viewport and synchronizes animation target; child selection restoration skips scrolling when original viewport exists. Old histories without viewport metadata retain existing visibility fallback.

Restore saved rectangle against nearest current monitor work area, reduce oversized dimensions and clamp position, using int64 arithmetic to avoid extreme-coordinate subtraction overflow. app_main integration performed by parent agent.

actual_tests.name: window_placement_test
actual_tests.includes: Synthetic removed right/left/top displays, negative-coordinate display, top taskbar, oversized/empty/extreme rects, plus actual MonitorFromRect/GetMonitorInfo lookup; no user window moved.

actual_tests.name: navigation_return_test
actual_tests.production_objects: Parent rebuilt pulse including all AppState/Tab ABI dependents. Private fixture relinked against the resulting production objects; shared build not written by this fixture.
actual_tests.includes: F17 content/name x Enter/live, whitespace, delayed history cancellation, late content generation rejection, home/This PC origin restoration, IME composing guard. F19 real 240-directory NTFS worker publication, Details2168->2168 and LargeIcons1632->1632, selected75, scroll-animation target, back/forward/repeated returns, legacy metadata fallback, model both-axis restoration and new-navigation history cancellation.

limits: No foreground keyboard/IME, real index-service ordering, or complete visible search-chain acceptance.
No physical monitor disconnect/reconnect; helper tested with supplied geometries and read-only live monitor lookup.
No user configuration, windows, clipboard, registry, recycle bin or service changed.
No full historical selftest suite or release build.
F09 startup call site inspected after parent integration; actual visible restored-session launch and physical screen unplug were not exercised.

additional_integration.behavior: InvalidateShellIcon for watch event name and old_name before refresh coalescing; overflow invalidates parent; explicit RefreshPath invalidates parent. Cache implementation and tests owned by preview agent.
